rules.title: Widgets never appear / shell does not start after login

fix.text: Check the user unit state and whether it is enabled.
fix.command: systemctl --user status caelestia-shell.service && systemctl --user is-enabled caelestia-shell.service

fix.text: Quickstart check: log out and back in, or start the shell directly.
If it still fails, run the shell in debug mode in a terminal and read the first error line.
fix.warning: This replaces the service-managed shell until you stop it; prefer the systemd unit afterwards.

rules.title: Unrecognized pragma / DBus UnknownObjectPath after an update (fixed on dev — update the shell)

fix.text: This exact pair of errors was fixed on the dev branch. Update through the shell: Nexus -> Updates -> branch 'dev' -> Install Updates.
Or from a terminal:
Restart through the unit afterwards.

rules.title: Quickshell errors/won't open right after updating to latest dev — reinstall the quickshell binary

fix.text: In the reported case the quickshell binary itself was stale/corrupt after the update; reinstalling it fixed it.
fix.command: sudo pacman -R quickshell-git && sudo pacman -S quickshell-git
fix.warning: Removes and reinstalls the quickshell package (AUR name may differ on your system — check 'pacman -Qs quickshell' first).

fix.text: Check which quickshell package you actually have before removing anything.
Then restart the shell unit.

rules.clarify_probe: Paste the exact first error line from 'journalctl --user -u caelestia-shell -n 50' — it separates this from the pragma error rule.

rules.title: 'Quickshell has crashed' dialog / window switcher stops listing windows (KWinActiveWindowBridge crash)

anyOf.value: window switcher no longer shows windows

fix.text: Restart the shell through the systemd unit (the clean path — same environment it started with).
If the unit restart hangs, force-stop the shell processes first, then restart.
fix.command: killall quickshell; killall qs; systemctl --user restart caelestia-shell.service
fix.warning: Kills the shell processes; any unsaved shell-side state is lost.

fix.text: Only as a last resort (config corruption suspected), reset the shell config — this wipes your Nexus customizations.
fix.warning: This is the documented full reset: ALL shell settings, keybinds and AI config return to defaults. Back up ~/.config/caelestia first.
fix.undo: Restore the backup you made before running this.

rules.title: Random app crashes (Chromium/Electron, Discord, Steam) alongside the shell — memory pressure pattern

fix.text: In the resolved report this was the shell's memory growth; updating to latest dev plus keeping Live previews and the overview OFF stopped it.
Measure before changing anything — is the shell process actually growing?
fix.command: systemd-cgtop -m; grep VmRSS /proc/$(pgrep -n quickshell)/status; systemctl show user@$(id -u).service -p MemoryPeak

fix.text: Update to latest dev (Nexus -> Updates, branch dev), then keep bar 'Live window previews' and Overview disabled until the next release.

rules.clarify_probe: Does 'systemd-cgtop -m' show the user slice climbing into swap during the crashes? (Paste the output.)

rules.title: Vesktop/Discord freezes when screen sharing or camera turns on (KWin screencast conflict)

fix.text: Disable live window previews: Nexus -> Taskbar -> 'Live window previews' toggle OFF.
Or set it directly in the shell settings (opens an editor; the shell applies it live).
Restart through the systemd unit so the change lands in the environment the shell started with.
fix.warning: Do NOT substitute 'caelestia shell -d': daemonising points the shell's stdio at /dev/null and apps launched from the shell inherit a dead stdout — that is the exact Vesktop deadlock from the issue.

rules.title: Stock Breeze lock screen appears instead of the Caelestia one

fix.text: Point the Plasma shell package back at caelestia and clear the greeter theme override.
Remove the stale greeter theme key.
Log out and back in — the autostart script self-heals the lock screen on the next login.
